tracks.why_en: Starts day one. Blocked by: nothing — this track starts first and gates six others.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：day one。前置条件：先行开工，无前置条件，并制约其余六条线。
tracks.blocked: nothing — this track starts first and gates six others

parcels.title_en: Buy or borrow one retail Microduck and log it in
parcels.title_zh: 购入或借用一台零售版 Microduck 并登记
parcels.deliverable: A photographic teardown log: every part as removed, with its position, orientation and fasteners, into images/teardown/ with a numbered index.
parcels.acceptance: Every one of the 15 servos, 3 boards, battery and both shells appears in at least one numbered photograph, and the index lists them all. Count photographs against the part list: no part unphotographed.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: every other parcel in this track, plus T2-1 and T5-1
parcels.needs: a purchased retail unit (SPENDING — Leif approves)
parcels.evidence: SPEC.md:24 — Pollen's mechanical CAD, BOM and PCBs are not published
parcels.days_basis: 1 unit: order, receive, unbox and photograph a full teardown. Rate: 2 d per unit, ASSUMED. Elapsed time is longer than the effort — shipping is not engineer-days.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Caliper every printed part against our model
parcels.title_zh: 用卡尺测量每个打印件并与模型比对
parcels.deliverable: out/factory/measure/caliper.json: measured L×W×H and every feature dimension per part, to 0.01 mm, beside our modelled value and the delta.
parcels.acceptance: Every part in the 30-part print list has a measured row; each row carries an instrument reading, not a modelled number. Deltas over 1.5 mm are listed separately as findings.
parcels.unblocks: closes the head-geometry CANNOT DETERMINE and the 1.5 mm rebuild rule
parcels.evidence: HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html — photo scale uncertainty ≈4 % ≈5 mm on a 122 mm head
parcels.days_basis: 30 printed parts x 0.13 engineer-day per part (about 1 h per part: fixture, caliper 3 axes plus features, record). Part count MEASURED (out/print/slice.json), rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Measure the head shell and eye ring to settle the +9.1 % ratio
parcels.title_zh: 测量头壳与眼圈，判定 +9.1 % 比例差
parcels.deliverable: A verdict on which of {eye ring OD, head width} deviates from our mesh, with the measured mm and the instrument.
parcels.acceptance: Ring OD and shell-rim width both measured to 0.1 mm; the front-view ratio recomputed from measurements rather than photographs; the CANNOT DETERMINE in HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html is replaced by a verdict.
parcels.unblocks: head tooling; the biggest open geometric question
parcels.evidence: HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html §1 — front-view ring/width ratio +9.1 %
parcels.days_basis: 2 dimensions, but the work is the setup: scale reference, repeat readings, recompute the front-view ratio. Rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

tracks.title_en: Components, electrical identity and the shelf
tracks.title_zh: 元器件识别、电气测量与零件档案
tracks.why_en: Starts after E1 has the unit apart. Blocked by: E1 (M-1): the unit must be open.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：after E1 has the unit apart。前置条件：需 E1 完成拆解。
tracks.starts: after E1 has the unit apart
tracks.blocked: E1 (M-1): the unit must be open

parcels.title_en: Identify every unidentified component from the teardown
parcels.title_zh: 通过拆解确认所有未知元器件
parcels.deliverable: A part number, package and vendor for the speaker, microphone, ToF generation, NFC front-end, camera module and its ribbon.
parcels.acceptance: Each line that currently reads CANNOT DETERMINE in ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html carries a marking read off the physical part, photographed.
parcels.unblocks: T3 sourcing lines and the electronics BOM
parcels.evidence: readiness.json — 10 of 32 bought lines are CANNOT DETERMINE
parcels.days_basis: 6 unidentified components x 0.33 d each: decap or read the marking under magnification, then search the marking to a datasheet. Component count MEASURED (readiness CANNOT DETERMINE rows), rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Measure the servo supply voltage on a running unit
parcels.title_zh: 测量运行中整机的舵机供电电压
parcels.deliverable: A meter reading of servo VDD with the robot standing and walking, against the XL330-M288-T published 3.7–6.0 V band.
parcels.acceptance: A number in volts at both states, with the meter and the probe point named. Either the servos see the raw 2S pack (6.6–8.4 V) or they do not; the answer is recorded either way.
parcels.unblocks: the entire power-path design; the most consequential electrical unknown
parcels.evidence: workflows/RUNNING.md finding 1 — the most important electrical finding in the project
parcels.days_basis: 1 bench session: rail voltages and standby current on a live unit. Rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Grade the 36 shelf records that need the sample
parcels.title_zh: 根据实物判定 36 项零件记录
parcels.deliverable: Each of the 36 triad part folders updated with the measured frame or dimension it was missing, and re-graded.
parcels.acceptance: `bin/triad check --all` reports fewer CANNOT DETERMINE than 47; every row that changes cites the caliper reading that changed it.
parcels.unblocks: the shelf reaching a defensible verdict
parcels.needs: the measurements from M-2 and M-4
parcels.evidence: readiness.json summary.triad_refs — 69 checked, 17 pass, 47 CANNOT DETERMINE
parcels.days_basis: 36 shelf records x 0.125 d each to write the measurement into the folder and re-run bin/triad check. Record count MEASURED (69 refs, 36 gradeable only from a unit), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.why_en: Starts day one. Blocked by: nothing — your own machines and materials answer this.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：day one。前置条件：可即刻开工，答案在贵厂自有设备与材料。
tracks.blocked: nothing — your own machines and materials answer this

parcels.title_en: State the process capability for each process you would use
parcels.title_zh: 给出各拟用工艺的过程能力
parcels.deliverable: Per process (FDM, SLA, injection moulding, CNC): the tolerance you hold in production, the surface finish, and the minimum wall.
parcels.acceptance: A number per process with the standard it is quoted against (e.g. ISO 2768 class, or a Cpk with the sample size). 'As printed' is not a tolerance and is rejected.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: every drawing's tolerance block; the joint tolerance stack
parcels.evidence: docs/MANUFACTURING-REQUIREMENTS.md A4 — every dimension carries a tolerance from a stated basis
parcels.days_basis: 4 processes x 0.375 d: collect the capability statement and turn it into the tolerance basis on our sheets. Process count MEASURED, rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Print and measure a tolerance coupon on your machines
parcels.title_zh: 在贵厂设备上打印并测量公差试片
parcels.deliverable: A coupon carrying the feature set this design uses — Ø2.2 clearance, Ø4.4 counterbore, Ø1.6 tap pilot, a 2 mm rib, a Ø16 boss and a Ø22 bore — printed and measured on your machines, in your material.
parcels.acceptance: Measured versus nominal for each feature, 5 specimens, with mean and spread. This replaces the CANNOT DETERMINE that currently blocks the whole tolerance stack.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: every press fit and every bearing seat verdict
parcels.evidence: out/open — 'This workshop's own printed dimensional band (the whole tolerance stack rests on it)'
parcels.days_basis: 6 feature families x 5 specimens = 30 coupons: 1 d printing (machine time, not engineer time), 1.5 d measuring, 0.5 d writing the capability record. Coupon count is the plan; rates ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Provide the material datasheet for the filament you would ship
parcels.title_zh: 提供拟用耗材的材料数据表
parcels.deliverable: Tensile and yield strength in the printed Z (interlayer) direction, not just XY, with the print parameters they were measured at.
parcels.acceptance: A datasheet page or a test report. If only XY data exists, say so — our FEA currently derates an assumed figure and that derating must be replaced by a measured one.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: every safety factor in STRUCTURAL.html
parcels.evidence: STRUCTURAL.html — 'Strength of the fitted filament in the printed orientation (every SF rests on it)'
parcels.days_basis: 2 materials: obtain the datasheets, re-run the FEA material sweep on the real numbers. The re-run itself is minutes — cecad.stress is already scripted.

tracks.title_en: Sourcing: quotes, lead times and the battery
tracks.why_en: Starts day one. Blocked by: nothing for the quotes; S-2 wants a label read on a real pack.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：day one。前置条件：报价可即刻开始；S-2 需读取实物电池标签。
tracks.blocked: nothing for the quotes; S-2 wants a label read on a real pack

parcels.title_en: Get a ROBOTIS OEM quote for the XL330-M288-T
parcels.title_zh: 取得 ROBOTIS XL330-M288-T 的 OEM 报价
parcels.deliverable: A written quote at 225 / 1 500 / 15 000 units (15 servos × 15 / 100 / 1000 robots), with lead time and MOQ.
parcels.acceptance: A quotation document. No distributor publishes a volume break for this part, so this is the single biggest lever on unit cost and only a quote can answer it.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: the entire unit-cost model at volume
parcels.needs: a supplier relationship (CONTACT — factory does this)
parcels.evidence: readiness.json — servos are 77 % of electronics cost at $358.50 of $465.64
parcels.days_basis: 3 quantity tiers across 32 lines: issue RFQ.html, chase, tabulate. Effort is chasing, not typing. Rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Resolve the compute board
parcels.title_zh: 确定主控板型号
parcels.deliverable: Either the real SKU fitted in a retail unit, or a chosen replacement with its mechanical and electrical differences listed.
parcels.acceptance: A board that can actually be ordered, in stock, with a lead time. The 1 GB / 32 GB combination stated in the press kit is not a Radxa catalogue SKU and every 1 GB variant read on 2026-09-02 was sold out.
parcels.depends: M-1 teardown confirms what is fitted
parcels.unblocks: the compute mount, the HAT connector layout, the power budget
parcels.evidence: spec/sourcing.json line B3 — 5 offers, 0 with a stated lead time
parcels.days_basis: 1 decision (which battery pack actually ships) once a label has been read on a real pack.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Close the remaining unpriced and lead-time-less lines
parcels.title_zh: 补齐其余物料的价格与交期
parcels.deliverable: A priced offer with a lead time for every bought line that lacks one.
parcels.acceptance: Zero lines in spec/sourcing.json with no priced offer; zero with no lead time. Currently 4 lines have no priced offer and 11 have no stated lead time.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: a defensible unit cost and a build schedule
parcels.evidence: readiness.json summary.bought_gaps
parcels.days_basis: 15 lines x 0.17 d: get a lead time stated in writing for the 11 lines that have none, and a price for the 4 that have none. Line counts MEASURED (readiness bought_gaps), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.why_en: Starts after E1 opens the unit; the Robot HAT half may start day one. Blocked by: E1 for the physical boards. If Pollen's published Apache-2.0 HAT is adopted (FACTORY-QUESTIONS Q5.4) this track loses about a third of its work.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：after E1 opens the unit; the Robot HAT half may start day one。前置条件：需 E1 取得实物板；若采用 Pollen 公开的 Apache-2.0 板，本线工作量减少约三分之一。
tracks.starts: after E1 opens the unit; the Robot HAT half may start day one
tracks.blocked: E1 for the physical boards. If Pollen's published Apache-2.0 HAT is adopted (FACTORY-QUESTIONS Q5.4) this track loses about a third of its work

parcels.title_en: Reverse-engineer the three boards from the physical samples
parcels.title_zh: 从实物逆向三块电路板
parcels.deliverable: A schematic per board with every component and every net, traced from the board itself.
parcels.acceptance: Every net traceable end to end; every component with a marking read off the part. The two currently-guessed parts — the Dynamixel half-duplex transceiver and the 2S→5V regulator — are identified, not inferred.
parcels.unblocks: all fabrication; nothing ships without these
parcels.needs: the physical boards, magnification, a meter
parcels.evidence: PCB-PACKAGE.html — Robot HAT reconstruction fails its own DRC
parcels.days_basis: 3 boards x 2 d: trace nets off the physical board under magnification and correct our schematic. The Robot HAT may collapse to 0 d if Pollen's published Apache-2.0 package is adopted instead (FACTORY-QUESTIONS Q5.4).
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Lay out and fabricate the banana battery-contact board
parcels.title_zh: 设计并打样电池触点板
parcels.deliverable: Gerbers, drill, pick-and-place and a BOM for the simplest of the three.
parcels.acceptance: A DRC-clean board and five fabricated samples that fit the measured pocket. This board is passive — VBAT and GND only — so it is the fastest win of the three.
parcels.unblocks: the power path; a buildable prototype
parcels.evidence: workflows/RUNNING.md — 'the banana contact board is passive and is ~1 day of work after one measurement session'
parcels.days_basis: 1 board (Robot HAT) re-routed to close 8 open nets and pass DRC against the fab's own rules. Open-net count MEASURED (electronics/pcb-package.json routing), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.title_en: Board fabrication, assembly and the test rig
tracks.why_en: Starts after E5 closes DRC. Blocked by: E5 (B-2) for the boards; a built unit for the gates.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：after E5 closes DRC。前置条件：需 E5 通过 DRC；判据执行需已装配整机。
tracks.blocked: E5 (B-2) for the boards; a built unit for the gates

parcels.title_en: Lay out and fabricate the Robot HAT and the IMU board
parcels.title_zh: 设计并打样 Robot HAT 与 IMU 板
parcels.deliverable: Gerbers, drill, pick-and-place, BOM and assembly drawings for both.
parcels.acceptance: DRC clean with zero fails (ours currently has 10), the 1.8 V codec rail terminated rather than dead-ending on a test point, and five assembled samples that power up.
parcels.unblocks: a working prototype
parcels.evidence: PCB-PACKAGE.html — 10 DRC fails; DVDD dead-ends on TP1
parcels.days_basis: 2 boards through fab and assembly: prepare the package, panelise, review the fab's DFM report. Excludes fab lead time.

parcels.title_en: Run the end-of-line test plan on the built unit
parcels.title_zh: 对整机执行下线测试方案
parcels.deliverable: A completed test record against TEST-PLAN.html's gates.
parcels.acceptance: Every gate passed or failed with the measured value. The walk acceptance thresholds come from simulation and have never been checked against hardware — that comparison is the deliverable.
parcels.unblocks: the acceptance criteria becoming real
parcels.needs: a built unit, a test bench
parcels.evidence: TEST-PLAN.html — the only artifact class currently graded READY
parcels.days_basis: 42 end-of-line gates x 0.06 d to run and log the first time, plus rig setup. Gate count MEASURED (TEST-PLAN.html Table 13), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.title_zh: 可制造性评审与打印文件
tracks.why_en: Starts day one. Blocked by: nothing — it reads our drawings and your process rules.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：day one。前置条件：可即刻开工，依据我方图纸与贵厂工艺规则。
tracks.blocked: nothing — it reads our drawings and your process rules

parcels.title_en: DFM review every part against your processes
parcels.title_zh: 按贵厂工艺对每个零件做可制造性审查
parcels.deliverable: Per part: what you would change to make it manufacturable, with the reason and the cost or cycle-time impact.
parcels.acceptance: A written finding per part, or an explicit 'no change needed'. Silence on a part is not an answer.
parcels.unblocks: the production geometry; possibly a re-model
parcels.evidence: MANUFACTURING-PLAYBOOK.html
parcels.days_basis: 30 parts x 0.1 d for a manufacturability opinion per part. Part count MEASURED, rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Quote injection moulding against the printed baseline
parcels.title_zh: 报价注塑方案并与打印方案比较
parcels.deliverable: Tooling cost, tooling lead time, per-part price and MOQ for the shells, against our printed cost, so the break-even quantity is a real number.
parcels.acceptance: A quote per shell part. Our current break-even analysis uses published list prices, not your rates, so it is indicative only.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: the volume decision
parcels.evidence: docs/PRODUCTION.md — cost at 1/10/100/1000
parcels.days_basis: 8 candidate parts for tooling: draft, wall, parting line, gate and ejector review. Candidate count MEASURED (5 shells + 3), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.title_en: First build, fixtures and first-article inspection
tracks.title_zh: 首台装配、工装与首件检验
tracks.why_en: Starts when parts and boards exist. Blocked by: printed parts, bought parts and boards; E6 for the boards.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：when parts and boards exist。前置条件：需打印件、外购件与电路板齐备；电路板来自 E6。
tracks.blocked: printed parts, bought parts and boards; E6 for the boards

parcels.title_en: Build one unit from the paper alone
parcels.title_zh: 仅依据文件装配一台整机
parcels.deliverable: A build log recording every step where the document was wrong, ambiguous, or assumed knowledge not on the page.
parcels.acceptance: A working unit, or a log of exactly where it stopped. Every defect found becomes a correction to MANUAL.md. This is the single best test of whether this pack is real.
parcels.unblocks: everything; it validates or refutes the whole pack
parcels.evidence: ce-assemblies/microduck/current/manual/MANUAL.md
parcels.days_basis: 1 unit built for the first time from the paper, recording every place the paper is wrong. 23 steps are known to assume knowledge that is not on the page (MEASURED), which is what makes this 3 d and not 1.

parcels.title_en: Specify and build the assembly fixtures
parcels.title_zh: 设计并制作装配工装
parcels.deliverable: The jigs the line needs: bearing press, servo-horn alignment, harness form board.
parcels.acceptance: Each fixture drawn and made, with the step it serves named. Our jig drawings exist but have never been made or used.
parcels.unblocks: repeatable assembly
parcels.evidence: MANUFACTURING-PLAYBOOK.html — six assembly jigs with verified A3 drawings
parcels.days_basis: 6 fixtures already drawn: print, fit, correct. Fixture count MEASURED (out/jigs), rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: First-article inspection report on the first five units
parcels.title_zh: 首批五台整机的首件检验报告
parcels.deliverable: One report per unit: every gate result, every dimension out of tolerance, every place the assembly document was wrong, and the time each station took.
parcels.acceptance: 5 units x 42 gates logged against a serial, and the report names every step of the assembly document that had to be corrected to build them.
parcels.unblocks: turns our simulated numbers into measured ones — the whole point of the pilot
parcels.needs: built units, the test bench, a caliper
parcels.evidence: spec/test-plan.json — 42 end-of-line gates, 0 exercised
parcels.days_basis: 5 first-article units inspected against the drawings and the gates, one report. Unit count is the pilot plan.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

tracks.why_en: Starts F-1 can start with printed coupons on day one; H-1 needs a built robot. Blocked by: F-1: printed specimens only. H-1: E8 (A-1), a robot to fit the loom into.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：F-1 can start with printed coupons on day one; H-1 needs a built robot。前置条件：F-1 只需打印试件，可即刻开始；H-1 需 E8 完成首台装配。
tracks.starts: F-1 can start with printed coupons on day one; H-1 needs a built robot
tracks.blocked: F-1: printed specimens only. H-1: E8 (A-1), a robot to fit the loom into

parcels.title_en: Build one harness and turn route floors into a cut list
parcels.title_zh: 实做一套线束，把走线下限转为下料表
parcels.deliverable: wiring/CUTLIST.md: a cut length and a tolerance for every cable, measured on a loom that has been fitted into a built robot, not computed in CAD.
parcels.acceptance: Every one of the 23 cable rows carries a cut length and a tolerance, and the 6 rows that are CANNOT DETERMINE today carry a connector part number. Today: 20 cuttable lengths, 0 tolerances.
parcels.depends: A-1 (a built robot to fit the loom into)
parcels.unblocks: harness purchasing, and the assembly station that fits it
parcels.needs: a real loom, crimp tooling, a built robot
parcels.evidence: wiring/cables.json — 23 rows, 0 with a tolerance field, lengths are route floors + slack
parcels.days_basis: 23 cable rows: build one loom, measure each cut length installed, set a tolerance from the measured spread. Cable count MEASURED (wiring/cables.json), rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Set the torque schedule by strip and pull-out test
parcels.title_zh: 通过滑牙与拔出试验确定扭矩表
parcels.deliverable: A torque per joint family with the test that produced it: torque-to-strip and pull-out force on printed bosses and on the XL330's own tapped holes.
parcels.acceptance: All three CANNOT DETERMINE torque rows in the playbook are replaced by a number with a test method and a specimen count. No chart figure is copied.
parcels.depends: C-2 (the production print profile), M-1 for a real servo case
parcels.unblocks: every assembly station step that tightens a screw
parcels.needs: a torque rig, printed specimens, a calibrated driver
parcels.evidence: tools/data/playbook.json torque — 3 of 3 CANNOT DETERMINE; ROBOTIS publishes no torque
parcels.days_basis: 3 joint families x 5 specimens: torque to failure and pull-out on printed bosses, then write the schedule. Torque is 3/3 CANNOT DETERMINE today (MEASURED).

tracks.why_en: Starts day one. Blocked by: nothing — but L-2 is worth more once E1's measurements exist.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：day one。前置条件：可即刻开工；但 L-2 在 E1 测量完成后价值更大。
tracks.blocked: nothing — but L-2 is worth more once E1's measurements exist

parcels.title_en: Settle whether units may be sold
parcels.title_zh: 确认整机是否可销售
parcels.deliverable: A written position on manufacturing and selling units derived from CC BY-SA-NC assets, and on what is ours versus upstream.
parcels.acceptance: A decision with the clause it rests on. Our reading: prototypes may be printed, units may NOT be sold, and only the 8 parametric rebuilds are ours. That reading is not legal advice.
parcels.depends: none — can start on day one
parcels.unblocks: tooling, and any commercial plan
parcels.needs: counsel, or a licence enquiry to Pollen (Leif sends)
parcels.evidence: LICENCE-POSITION.html; microduck_rl README §License
parcels.days_basis: 1 decision. Effort is reading and writing; the elapsed time depends on counsel or on Pollen answering.

parcels.title_en: Replace every non-commercial mesh with an owned rebuild
parcels.title_zh: 用自研重建件替换全部非商业网格
parcels.deliverable: 22 vendor meshes replaced by parametric parts we own, each graded against the reference to the 1.0 mm p95 rule.
parcels.acceptance: `out/verify/mech_dims.json` shows a rebuild for every part, each passing the rebuild protocol. 8 of 30 are done today.
parcels.depends: L-1 (only if selling is the goal), M-2
parcels.unblocks: a commercially clean product
parcels.needs: CAD work — an agent can do this, given the measurements
parcels.evidence: readiness.json summary.print_licence — 22 vendor meshes, 8 ours
parcels.days_basis: 22 vendor meshes x 0.5 d to rebuild parametrically and grade against the reference to the 1.0 mm p95 rule. Mesh count MEASURED (readiness print_licence), rate ASSUMED and the most uncertain number in this table — the 8 already done took an agent, not an engineer.

in_flight.en: Drawing sheets rebuilt to the A2/A3/A4 standard: no tessellation texture, ≥6 shaded renders per sheet, ≥85 % sheet coverage, ≥3.5 mm text, and 100 % dimension coverage proved by bin/sheetcheck
in_flight.zh: 按 A2/A3/A4 标准重建图纸

in_flight.en: Every screw, insert, washer and ball joint measured off the geometry and placed into the assembly through a connection, then audited so no hole is unaccounted for
in_flight.zh: 测量并装入全部紧固件

in_flight.en: The open CANNOT DETERMINE items researched to a verdict or narrowed to a named physical test
Photo pose-matching as a mechanical feasibility proof, and the wiring made visible in our renders
in_flight.zh: 姿态比对与线束可视化

in_flight.en: Cables and connectors as real shelf parts, routed as solids in the assembly, with cut lengths and range-of-motion slack

effort_note: Every day figure is an ESTIMATE. No measured time-per-item exists in this workshop: 0 units built. Each parcel states the measured COUNT and the assumed per-item rate its estimate is arithmetic on.
